PR Info:

Title: 'Retry failed HTTP requests'

Branch: 'feature/http-retry'

Description:
======
Adds a bounded retry loop to the HTTP client.

Closes the body on success.
======

Main PR language: 'Go'


The PR Git Diff:
======
## File: 'internal/httpx/retry.go'

+	for attempt := 0; attempt < c.maxRetries; attempt++ {
+		resp, err := c.send(req)
+		if err == nil {
+			return resp.Body.Close()
+		}
+		lastErr = err
+	}
